name: Chau Son Monastery
summary: Brick Gothic monastery in Nho Quan: visit after prayer, 35 km from the city. The church, built from 1939, runs about 64 m, with a white dome of 21 m. Weekday windows are 8:00–10:30 and 14:30–16:30. Sunday is shorter. Around March, and at the start of August, the church closes to visitors.
dotReason: A quiet brick church on the way toward the park, with short visiting windows
getThere: Xã Phú Sơn, Nho Quan, 35 km from the city and 97 km from Hà Nội.
heroCaption: The long brick church of Châu Sơn, with karst behind the roof

notice.title: The visiting windows are short
notice.body: After prayer the church opens 8:00–10:30 and 14:30–16:30, and on Sunday 8:00–10:00 and 15:30–16:30. Ordinary days limit visitors. Around March, and at the start of August, it closes to visitors.

body: Châu Sơn is a Cistercian monastery at xã Phú Sơn, huyện Nho Quan, in the diocese of Phát Diệm. It was founded on 8 September 1936. The brick church went up from 1939, on an east–west axis, Gothic in outline: walls about 0.6 m thick, columns about 1.2 m, a run of about 64 m, and a white dome of 21 m inside. Palms and garden plots sit in front of the long roof, with the karst behind it.

You see the church and the grounds, after the community has finished prayer. Weekday visiting is 8:00–10:30 and 14:30–16:30. Sunday is 8:00–10:00 and 15:30–16:30. Ordinary days limit who comes in. Around March, and at the start of August, the church closes to visitors. Dress covers shoulders and knees.

It is 35 km from Ninh Bình city, 97 km from Hà Nội, and 65 km from the Phát Diệm church. Pair it with Cúc Phương when you are already on the Nho Quan road. The second frame is the long side wall, windows in two tiers, in warmer light.

figures.caption: The side of the brick church, windows in two rows
figures.alt: The long brick side of Chau Son monastery under a pale sky

gettingThere: Xã Phú Sơn, huyện Nho Quan. It is 35 km from Ninh Bình city, 97 km from Hà Nội, and 65 km from nhà thờ Phát Diệm. The road is the Nho Quan side of the province, the same direction as Cúc Phương.

legs.heading: From Ninh Binh
legs.body: About 35 km to xã Phú Sơn. Arrive for the morning window, which ends at 10:30, or 10:00 on Sunday.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: About 97 km. From Phát Diệm the distance is 65 km.

closed: Around March, and the start of August. Ordinary days limit visitors.
admissionNote: The visit is the church and the grounds after prayer.
